title: The Board Game with an Extra Token
youtube_title: The Board Game with an Extra Token | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Saving a place is a way of saying you belong.
summary: At a meadow gate where games start, Nim is just outside the fun, close to a board game that had an extra token in the box. Bodhi changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Nim has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Mr. Ade lets the children solve it.
